title: Atlas Hiring Plan
body_markdown:
Owner: Priya Natarajan with support from Joe Smith.
## Roles for the Lisbon hub
- 1 hub manager (start January 2027)
- 12 delivery drivers (start February 2027)
- 2 warehouse leads
- 1 customer support specialist, Portuguese and English
Recruiting begins in November 2026. Interviews are coordinated by Maria Lopez for budget alignment.
